text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the previous glory of the Mejiro 
family was still fresh in everyone's 
minds, Mejiro Dober's challenge in the 
Twinkle Series was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal is to become a strong Umamusume 
who can run with confidence at all times. 
She declares her determination to give her 
all in her debut race first—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Bright, a fellow Mejiro 
family Umamusume from the same generation, 
appeared. Running alongside Mejiro Dober 
in a thrilling exhibition, they fired up 
the surrounding crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Convinced that Mejiro Dober and Mejiro 
Bright will make great rivals for each 
other, your three years with Mejiro Dober 
begin!
